_description: Copy this file to path-config.json when local paths need to be customized. Relative paths are resolved from the project root. Leave values empty to use environment variables, PATH, or the portable project defaults.

python._description: Optional Python executable path. Used by Node/PowerShell helpers. Empty means PYTHON, PYTHON_EXE, then PATH lookup.

node._description: Optional Node.js executable path. Empty means NODE, NODE_EXE, then PATH lookup.

cloudflared._description: Optional cloudflared executable path for Inception tunnel scripts. Empty means CLOUDFLARED, CLOUDFLARED_EXE, then PATH lookup.

powershell._description: Optional PowerShell executable path used by Python helpers. Empty means POWERSHELL_EXE, then powershell/pwsh from PATH.

browser._description: Optional Chromium browser paths for login helpers. Empty means BROWSER_PATH/EDGE_PATH/CHROME_PATH or common Edge/Chrome/Yandex locations from Windows environment folders.

chat2api._description: Chat2API desktop storage root. Empty means CHAT2API_ROOT or %APPDATA%/chat2api.

profiles._description: Dedicated Chromium user-data-dir roots used by auth launchers and credential extractors.

authOutputs._description: Credential JSON output files produced by extraction scripts.

googleAiStudioWeb._description: Source files used by scripts/get-google-ai-studio-web-creds.py. Empty source paths default to the current user's Desktop export files.

reports._description: Local report output paths used by ad-hoc test scripts.
